name: Gift of Lights - Now Playing
author: Mahaska Drug
description: Sends the song that is playing (title, artist) and the show (playlist name) to the Gift of Lights page on mahaskadrug.com as each song starts.

privacy.summary: While switched on, sends each song's title and artist and the playlist name to the website address you enter.

sends.what: song title, artist and playlist name
sends.why: show now playing on the Gift of Lights web page
